body_text:
A *partition* $P$ of a closed bounded interval $[a, b]$ is a
finite ordered sequence of points
$a = x_0 < x_1 < x_2 < \dots < x_n = b$. The *mesh* (or norm)
of $P$ is the length of its longest subinterval:
$\|P\| = \max_{1 \leq i \leq n} (x_i - x_{i-1})$. A *tagged
partition* additionally associates a sample point
$t_i \in [x_{i-1}, x_i]$ with each subinterval.
